lunuz tools 1.0.5 - como instalar cada formato
==============================================

.deb   sudo apt install ./lunuz-tools_1.0.5_all.deb
.rpm   sudo dnf install ./lunuz-tools-1.0.5-1.noarch.rpm
.pkg   sudo pacman -U lunuz-tools-1.0.5-1-any.pkg.tar.zst
tar    tar -xJf lunuz-tools-1.0.5.tar.xz && cd lunuz-tools-1.0.5 && python3 -m lunuz gui
zip    unzip lunuz-tools-1.0.5.zip && cd lunuz-tools-1.0.5 && python3 -m lunuz gui

flatpak (fonte):  flatpak-builder --user --install build org.davi.lunuz-tools.json
snap (fonte):     cd snapcraft.yaml-dir && snapcraft     (requer snapd)
dnf/yum repo:     hospede o .rpm em uma URL e adicione lunuz-tools.repo
                  sudo dnf config-manager --add-repo lunuz-tools.repo
